thread:
oliver: Quick internal heads-up — Hosted Streaming v2 is GA. This adds server-side chunking improvements, lower memory for long-lived streams, and first-class tool-calling over streaming. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/streaming-v2-ga :confetti_ball:

maya: Nice! Any consumer changes?

oliver: Minimal breaking changes. New streaming endpoint is `/v1/streaming.run`. Old endpoints continue to work but won't get the memory/perf benefits. SDKs: bump to client v1.11.0 for built-in reconnect helpers.

jas: Rollout plan?

oliver: Rolling to 20% now -> 60% in 4h -> full in 24h if no regressions. We'll land per-route feature flags so customers can switch without changing model names.

eng-oncall: Please monitor p99 stream disconnects and streaming buffer growth. Alert if disconnects > 2% for 15m.

deploy-bot: [deploy] streaming-v2 rollout batch-1 started (20% traffic) at 2026-04-12T09:13:09Z

maya: Function/tool-calls over streaming — any auth changes?

oliver: Same function schema. We added a `streaming_tool_token` header for short-lived tool auth in streaming sessions. Migration guide has examples.

jas: Marketing will schedule banner + changelog. Can we get a one-liner about cost impact?

oliver: No token cost change. Slight infra premium on tiny fraction of sessions due to longer-lived sockets; we surfaced it in Console cost estimator.

maya: Thanks team. I'll post a short internal FAQ in #product and flag enterprise PMs about Dedicated timing (not GA for Dedicated yet).
